name: After § 64
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text: 66a. Strongly condemns the assault on the EU’s southern border in the city of Ceuta, carried out on 30 and 31 July 2026, as well as the subsequent invasion of Ceuta, constituting an attack on the territorial integrity and sovereignty of a Member State; deplores the use of irregular migration flows as an instrument of hybrid warfare directed against the stability and security of a Member State, and therefore calls for an independent and comprehensive investigation to clarify responsibility for the planning and execution of this attack and identify the objectives pursued;
